decision: Close the V430 five-head/432-neuron conditional-support candidate and do not train a router. Even target-aware held-out selection misses both gates severely; the five-head attention intermediate is already inadequate, and every source head and neuron is selected somewhere. Authorize a complete-cost review of one materially distinct shared low-rank all-head source-attention factorization that preserves every attention pattern while replacing exact-head selection. No head-count, neuron-width, selection-rule, data, seed, or gate variants are authorized.
claim_boundary: Negative permanently nonpromotional target-aware conditional-support capacity evidence only; no router, component, runtime, autonomous, complete-model, Phase 3, or superiority claim.
